name: Suggia International Award Concert
description: Witness the next generation of classical talent as promising young cellists perform with the Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música.
longDescription:
The Suggia International Award Concert showcases the culmination of a prestigious competition dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in classical cello. This annual event, held in honour of the celebrated Portuguese cellist Guilhermina Suggia, provides a significant platform for young musicians to perform with a professional orchestra. The concert features the award winner, selected from a rigorous international competition, performing a concerto with the Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música, under the direction of a guest conductor.

Attendees will experience an evening of classical music in the grand setting of Sala Suggia. The concert typically runs for approximately two hours, including an intermission. The atmosphere is one of focused appreciation for the artistry of the young soloist and the orchestral performance. The audience primarily consists of classical music enthusiasts, supporters of emerging artists, and members of the local music community. Sala Suggia, known for its excellent acoustics and modern design, offers a comfortable and immersive concert experience.

Tickets for the Suggia International Award Concert are priced variably and can be purchased through the Casa da Música box office or website. The venue, Casa da Música, is conveniently located and accessible via public transport; the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent. Several bus lines also stop nearby. The building is designed with accessibility in mind, offering ramps and lifts.
